parts.text: Which claim about the path length is correct?

options.text: Measure the straight part as $5$ grid units and treat the diagonal as longer than one straight grid unit, then add those lengths.
Count the diagonal cut as $1$ grid unit, the same as a straight side.
The path length is the printed label "square-grid paper".

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kabir traces a path on square-grid paper. One segment runs $5$ straight grid units along the lines; the next segment cuts diagonally across one square.

part_answers.answer: Straight grid steps and a diagonal cut across a square do not have the same length, so each segment must be measured or estimated on its own before adding.

teacher.key_rationale: Boundary length adds each segment's own measure. A diagonal across a square is longer than one straight grid unit, so it must not be counted as 1 straight unit.
